result.rationale: The diff shows the cancel flow previously only used credentials from bookingToDelete.user.credentials.find(credential => credential.id === credentialId); the new code adds a fallback `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` with no ownership check (no userId comparison against bookingToDelete.user.id). So a reference with a mismatched/stale credentialId now causes calendar.deleteEvent to run with an arbitrary credential from the DB, a real authorization-scope expansion introduced by this change.
